name: ritual_crucifix_flat
description: a dark-wood Latin crucifix lying flat on the altar cloth, seen from straight above: long axis E-W, head W, crossbar N-S; a pale corpus face up (the chest the one highlight). Not a pickup (no glint).
altar_slot_note: ritual_altar.json slot `crucifix`: frame centre (120, 70) on level 1 (the middle level), 36 x 24. Place it unrotated (head W).
facing_note: drawn head W. Turned so the foot points N (screen up) it reads as an inverted cross: if Godot ever rotates it, keep the head W or N.
